meta.name: heathershire
meta.prompt: Heathershire, a dense countryside shire packed with everything a shire has. A village high street runs off a green with a moot hall, an inn, a terraced row and the parish's charitable houses, dressed with lamp posts, benches, a fountain and the whole clutter of street furniture. North of it a manor and its mansion sit behind a gated drive with stables and a dovecote; west, farm country crowds a windmill, an oast, a silo and a dozen yards together. An eastern show-hamlet ring stands one house from each of eighteen building traditions on its own plot, from an igloo to a hacienda. A drovers' camp squats on the south-west moor, and the Heather Water runs south to a broad with a houseboat moored on it.
